verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several ways Claude can operate a browser for the user. The Cowork built-in browser lets Claude open sites, read pages, click, type and fill forms while you watch. The Claude in Chrome extension lets Claude read, click and navigate websites alongside you. Computer use and agentic Research cover the research side of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that browser-driven task completion works reliably in practice.
